## You can smell AI writing now

Readers can tell now, and so can the search engines that rank your page. A lot of them quietly push that kind of writing down.

That is a problem when you used AI to fix your grammar and your own draft now reads like a robot wrote it. Our engine pulls the writing back toward the way you talk, so it sounds like you again and gets past the filters.
